message:
Thanks, Mike, that's a lot clearer...though I would have been stymied by "write and learn." I would have found it too cryptic, too Yoda-like. Heh. So would that essay [I love](http://culturecat.net/node/715), [Hungry for Air](http://bostonreview.net/BR30.1/deborahstone.html), be an example of what you're talking about?

Also, have you read *Writing from the Center* by Scott Russell Sanders? A friend of mine from my master's program loved it, and I recently checked it out from the library. Those essays might count as the kind of writing you're talking about, too.
